markers.name: Mihara_P2
say: This truly is a mysterious place.

One month... That's still plenty of time
before the collar needs to be replaced, so it should be fine.
markers.label: NPC 7019012

markers.name: Mori_P2
say:
I can't trust anyone. 
I can't...
I can't believe we've gotta wait here for a whole month...
So are we really underwater right now?
markers.label: NPC 7019016

markers.name: Mihara_P3
say:
I'm fine, Yuni. I'm not hurt at all. 
There's no pain whatsoever.
markers.label: NPC 7019012

markers.name: Mihara_P4
say: Do I really need to leave Siren behind, all alone?
markers.label: NPC 7019012

markers.name: Mori_P4
say:
I'll be able to go outside soon.
But Siren will be left alone...
Why doesn't Siren want to go outside?
markers.label: NPC 7019016

markers.name: Mori_P8
say:
Finally, I can go outside... together with Siren. 
I can save her!
Yuni, Mihara... Hold on a little longer.
markers.label: NPC 7019016

markers.name: Cind_P9
say: This must be the place that Siren made.
This place reminds me of her: beautiful and comforting.
markers.label: NPC 7019014

markers.name: Grave_P9
say: The potential uses for the bubbles are endless.

To think this is a weapon which I created...
Someday, I want to make something like this again.
markers.label: NPC 7019015

markers.name: Mihara_P9
say:
Haha, you find us being inside the ocean awfully intriguing,
don't you, Yuni?

We'll come back to this place,
even if we don't know exactly when that will be.
markers.label: NPC 7019012

markers.name: Mori_P9
say:
This is really inside the ocean! 
It's so beautiful!

I rescued Siren.
No one can imagine how happy that makes me.
markers.label: NPC 7019016

notes.text: Mihara, Yuni, and Mori have left for the surface.
The bubbles finally reached the sea surface on the surface.
Little Mermaid is finally reunited with those she missed dearly.
